build_detectron_cython_extensions: build the detectron package by running setup.py to compile cython_bbox and cython_nms Cython extensions
run_setup_detectron: run python setup.py install to install the detectron package with compiled Cython modules
review_ext_modules: review the ext_modules list that defines cython_bbox and cython_nms Extension objects for detectron
summarize_setup_py: summarize the setup.py configuration that registers detectron as a package with two Cython extensions
test_cython_extension_build: test that the cython_bbox and cython_nms extensions compile correctly with numpy include dirs
